![Hooded Parrot](image/orchids.jpg)
We are investigating occurrence data of [**orchids(Orchidaceae)**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orchid) in Australia from the **Atlas of Living Australia**, and make a map showing the spatial locations of sightings from 2014 to 2024.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load required packages
library(galah)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(geosphere)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Set up ALA Access
galah_config(email = "vahdatjavad@gmail.com")

# Define and perform the search
orchids_taxon <- search_taxa("Orchidaceae")
occ_data <- galah_call() |> 
  galah_identify(orchids_taxon) |>  
  galah_filter(year >= 2014, year <= 2024) |>
  galah_select(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, year, eventDate, scientificName) |>
  atlas_occurrences()
  
# Drop records with missing coordinates
orchids <- occ_data |> 
  filter(!is.na(decimalLatitude), !is.na(decimalLongitude), !is.na(eventDate)) |> 
  mutate(
    obs_lat = decimalLatitude,
    obs_lon = decimalLongitude,
    eventDate = ymd_hms(eventDate),
    datetime = eventDate,
    month = month(eventDate),
    day = day(eventDate),
    weekday = wday(eventDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    dayofyear = yday(eventDate),
    scientificName = str_remove(scientificName, "\\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)")
  ) %>%
  select(obs_lat, obs_lon, year, month, day, weekday, dayofyear, datetime, scientificName)

#save data
usethis::use_data(orchids, overwrite = TRUE)
```

#### Weekly Distribution of organism 

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
week_order <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
orchids |> drop_na(weekday) |> 
ggplot(aes(x = factor(weekday, levels = week_order))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Week Days Distribution of Glowworm Occurrences",
    x = "Week day", y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#### In this section we want to find nearest weather station for each occrurance of Orchids

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# load data sets
load("../data/orchids.rda")
load("../data/weather_stations.rda")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

# For each occurrence, find the nearest station
nearest_station_ids <- sapply(1:nrow(orchids), function(i) {
  dists <- distHaversine(
    cbind(weather_stations$stn_lon, weather_stations$stn_lat),
    c(orchids$obs_lon[i], orchids$obs_lat[i])
  )
  weather_stations$stnid[which.min(dists)]
})

# Add the nearest station ID to the platypus data
orchids$weather_station_id <- nearest_station_ids

# Join orchid data with weather station metadata
orchids_ws <- orchids %>%
  left_join(weather_stations, by = c("weather_station_id" = "stnid"))

# save dataset
usethis::use_data(orchids_ws)
```

```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
load("../data/orchids_ws.rda")
head(orchids_ws, n = 3)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate frequency by state
state_freq <- table(orchids_ws$state)

# Sort by frequency (descending order)
state_freq <- sort(state_freq, decreasing = TRUE)

#Convert to data frame for better presentation
state_freq_df <- as.data.frame(state_freq)
colnames(state_freq_df) <- c("State", "Frequency")
state_freq_df
```

#### Pattern Analysis

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# Extract month
orchids_ws$month <- format(orchids_ws$datetime, "%B")
orchids_ws$month_num <- as.numeric(format(orchids_ws$datetime, "%m"))

ggplot(orchids_ws, aes(x = factor(month, levels = month.name))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Distribution of Orchid Occurrences (2024) vs each state",
    x = "Month", y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  facet_wrap(.~state , scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))  # Add padding for labels
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Weekly patterns

# Convert to date format
orchids_ws$date <- as.Date(orchids_ws$datetime)

orchids_ws <- orchids_ws %>%
  mutate(week = week(date),
         week_start = floor_date(date, "week"))

# Weekly aggregation
weekly_counts <- orchids_ws %>%
  count(week_start, state)

# Seasonal plot
ggplot(weekly_counts, aes(x = week_start, y = n, group = state)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2ca02c") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d62728") +
  facet_wrap(~state, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Weekly Occurrence Patterns with Trend Lines",
       x = "Week Starting", y = "Observations") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# First create month column if not already present
orchids_ws <- orchids_ws %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(datetime),  # Ensure date format
    month = format(date, "%B"),  # Full month name
    month_num = as.numeric(format(date, "%m"))  # Month number
  )


# Monthly patterns by state
state_monthly <- orchids_ws %>%
  group_by(state, month) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * count / sum(count))

# Circular seasonality plot
ggplot(state_monthly, aes(x = month, y = percent, color = state, group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = month.name) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Patterns by State",
       x = NULL, y = "Percentage of Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Clean and prepare data
df <- orchids_ws %>%
   filter(!is.na(obs_lat), !is.na(obs_lon), !is.na(month)) %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name))  # Ensure proper month order

# Load Australia base map (sf object)
aus_map <- ne_states(country = "Australia", returnclass = "sf")

# Create faceted map by month
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = aus_map, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = obs_lon, y = obs_lat, color = state), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = stn_lon, y = stn_lat), shape = 2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5)+
  coord_sf(xlim = c(110, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Orchid Sightings in Australia",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "State"
  )


```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ggplot() +

 geom_point(data = df, aes(x = obs_lon, y = obs_lat, color = state), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
```

### Datasets Overview

We have organized the orchid occurrence and weather station data into the following structured datasets, stored in the data/ directory:

-   `orchids_2024.rda` Contains orchid occurrence records across all states in Australia.

-   `orchids_2024_ws.rda` An enhanced version of the occurrence data, merged with the nearest weather station information, including:

    <div>

    ```         
    --Station ID (weather_station_id)

    --Station name (stname)

    --Geographic details (lat.y, lon.y, address, city, state)
    ```

    </div>

-   `orchids_top_weather.rda` Focuses on weather data from the top 3 most frequently recorded stations associated with orchid occurrences.

-   `weather_stations.rda` A standalone dataset of all unique weather stations in Australia, providing reference metadata for cross-referencing.
